title: Signed-total tensor models on flat K-flat small pro-etale representatives
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on this site and write $\mathcal M_R$ for its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $D(R)$ for its ordinary unbounded derived category with localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The ordinary tensor $M\otimes_R N$ is the sheafification of the sectionwise balanced tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; the section $m\otimes n$ means its canonical sheafification image over every site object. Let $\mathcal P_R$ be the full subcategory of cochain complexes $P$ which are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and whose terms are flat module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. A signed-total tensor model consists of a bifunctor $\tau:D(R)\times D(R)\to D(R)$ together with a natural isomorphism on $\mathcal P_R\times\mathcal P_R$,
$$Q\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R Q')\xrightarrow{\sim}\tau(QP,QQ'),$$
where the total tensor is the direct-sum total cochain complex with differential $d_P\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_{Q'}$ on bidegree $(p,q)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. This defines the presentation data, not a choice of arbitrary unnormalized comparison. No boundedness, completion, flatness of $R$, or equality of site object and morphism universes is imposed. For $X:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$ the site has object universe $u+1$, morphism universe $u$, and the coefficient and module sections have universe $u+1$.
